title: Polytropon shared/private skill bank with Mirror skill views
hypothesis: On 12 task functions composed from six aligned logical skills and four unrelated private skills, three physical shared skills plus rank-one Mirror Views and a four-skill private fallback will reach mean query RMSE <=0.03 with <=0.80x the actual bytes of an explicit ten-skill Polytropon bank, while preserving sparse task allocations; direct shared-basis low-rank control tests attribution.
physical_object: three shared 8x8 physical skill matrices, one shared rank-one View basis, and four private full skill matrices for unrelated functions
mirror_coordinate: one scalar View code for each of six logical skills generated from a shared rank-one matrix basis
logical_multiplicity: six logical shared skills from three physical skills plus four private skills, composed by a sparse task-skill allocation table
controls: Polytropon-style explicit ten-skill matrix bank with sparse task-skill allocations
three physical shared skills without Mirror views plus four private full skills
same three-base plus rank-one skill Views and private bank as a direct native low-rank control
independent full task matrix per each of 12 task functions

task.type: synthetic 8D linear regression; eight tasks compose two of six aligned skills; four outlier tasks use one unrelated private skill

development.selection_metric: mean query output RMSE across 12 tasks; report composition/private task split, active skills, physical modules, bytes and compute

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds: mean query RMSE <=0.03, Mirror payload <=0.80x explicit skill bank, no more than seven physical skill matrices total, inference ops/example <=1.25x skill bank, and native shared-basis control does not exactly match Mirror.
gates.FAIL: Either seed misses a PROMISING clause or native shared-basis skill control exactly aliases Mirror outputs/payload.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent task upper control has mean query RMSE >0.025 on either seed, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Synthetic linear skill composition, not a Polytropon reproduction or natural task benchmark.
Task-skill allocations are known and paid; this screen isolates skill-bank representation, not learned routing quality.
Four unrelated functions are assigned private skills by the frozen task design; no adaptive birth threshold is claimed.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING gate passes.
